# @liaugust/monobank-sdk

> Unofficial, strict, runtime-validated TypeScript SDK for Monobank Public and
> Personal API endpoints. Supports Node.js 20.19.5+, ESM, CommonJS, and modern
> browser bundlers. Zod Mini validates every successful JSON response.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@liaugust/monobank-sdk
Repository: https://github.com/liaugust/monobank-typescript-sdk
API reference: https://github.com/liaugust/monobank-typescript-sdk/blob/main/docs/API.md
License: MIT

## Use the package

Install with `pnpm add @liaugust/monobank-sdk` or
`npm install @liaugust/monobank-sdk`.

Import only from `@liaugust/monobank-sdk`.

```ts
import { MonobankPersonalClient } from "@liaugust/monobank-sdk";

const client = new MonobankPersonalClient({
  token: validatedConfig.monobankToken,
});
```

## Client methods

- `getBankSync(options?)`: public `/bank/sync`; no `X-Token`; returns
  `Promise<BankSync>`.
- `getCurrencyRates(options?)`: public `/bank/currency`; no `X-Token`; returns
  `Promise<readonly CurrencyRate[]>`.
- `getClientInfo(options?)`: authenticated `/personal/client-info`; returns
  `Promise<ClientInfo>`; upstream limit is one call per 60 seconds.
- `getStatements(input, options?)`: authenticated statements; returns
  `Promise<readonly StatementItem[]>`; maximum inclusive window is 2,682,000
  seconds; `Date` inputs become Unix seconds.
- `setWebhook(input, options?)`: authenticated webhook mutation; accepts an
  absolute HTTP(S) URL or `""` to remove it; never retried automatically.
- `parsePersonalWebhookEvent(input)`: validates webhook JSON shape; does not
  authenticate the sender.

Each optional request `options` object accepts `signal?: AbortSignal`.

## Constructor options

- `token: string`: required Personal API token; sent only to authenticated
  `/personal/*` methods.
- `fetch?: FetchLike`: injected Fetch-compatible implementation.
- `baseUrl?: string`: absolute HTTP(S) origin for controlled proxies or tests.
- `timeoutMs?: number`: per-attempt timeout in milliseconds.
- `retry?: { baseDelayMs; maxAttempts; maxDelayMs }`: bounded retry policy for
  safe GET requests. Retries are disabled when omitted.

## Errors

- `MonobankValidationError`: invalid configuration or method input before
  Fetch.
- `MonobankNetworkError`: Fetch failure with reason `network`, `timeout`, or
  `aborted`.
- `MonobankApiError`: non-2xx response; includes status and optional
  `retryAfterMs` and safe upstream message.
- `MonobankResponseValidationError`: successful payload failed runtime schema
  validation.

Errors intentionally do not retain tokens, authorization headers, Request
objects, or raw Personal payloads.

## Exported runtime values

- Enum-like const objects: `AccountType`, `CashbackType`.
- Schemas: `accountSchema`, `bankSyncSchema`, `clientInfoSchema`,
  `currencyRateSchema`, `currencyRatesSchema`, `jarSchema`,
  `managedAccountSchema`, `managedClientSchema`, `statementItemSchema`,
  `statementItemsSchema`, `personalWebhookEventSchema`.
- Errors: `MonobankApiError`, `MonobankNetworkError`,
  `MonobankResponseValidationError`, `MonobankValidationError`.
- Client/parser: `MonobankPersonalClient`, `parsePersonalWebhookEvent`.

See `src/index.ts` for the complete authoritative export list, including types.

## Data rules

- Monetary integers use the currency's minor units.
- Currency codes are numeric ISO 4217 codes.
- Rate and statement timestamps are Unix seconds.
- `BankSync.serverTimeMsec` is Unix milliseconds.
- Response schemas preserve unknown additive fields.
- Upstream field spelling is preserved, including `webHookUrl`.

## Safety rules for generated code

- Never expose, log, or commit a real Personal token or banking payload.
- Never send `X-Token` to public `/bank/*` endpoints.
- Never treat webhook parsing as sender authentication.
- Never retry `setWebhook()` automatically.
- Do not invent Acquiring APIs; they are not in the current public surface.
- Prefer exported SDK types, schemas, value objects, and error classes over
  duplicate local definitions.
- Validate environment configuration before constructing the client.
